$comment: Inputs for scripts/build-shield-rules.py. Lists are converted to declarativeNetRequest static rules at build time; nothing is fetched at runtime, so blocking works offline and leaks no URLs. Licences of remote lists are noted - keep them intact when redistributing.
$budgetNote: 30,000 is Chromium's GUARANTEED_MINIMUM_STATIC_RULES. Going above it means competing for a global pool shared with every other installed extension, and rules can be silently dropped - which looks exactly like 'the ad blocker stopped working'. Do not raise this without reading docs/decisions/ADR-0003.

sources.note: Large general-purpose adware/tracker/malware list. Skipped silently if the build has no network.
Disabled by default: GPL-3.0 obligations are incompatible with shipping closed binaries. Enable only for internal builds.
